Build a 10k/10k resistive voltage divider between +3V3 and GND, with the
midpoint net labeled VOUT. Work inside the schematic at C:/Users/FlowUP/AppData/Local/Temp/kam-agent-model_divider-mytovuxs/divider.kicad_sch, in a project
created at C:/Users/FlowUP/AppData/Local/Temp/kam-agent-model_divider-mytovuxs named divider.

NOTES:
Device:R pins sit at (component_x, component_y - 3.81) for pin 1 and
(component_x, component_y + 3.81) for pin 2. Place R1 at (100.33, 80.01)
and R2 at (100.33, 95.25), so R1's pin 2 (100.33, 83.82) and R2's pin 1
(100.33, 91.44) can be wired together, with the VOUT label at their
midpoint (100.33, 87.63). Each power rail needs a PWR_FLAG anchored at the
same coordinate as its power symbol or ERC reports the rail as not driven:
+3V3 and a PWR_FLAG at (100.33, 76.2), GND and a PWR_FLAG at
(100.33, 99.06). Every coordinate above is already a multiple of the
1.27mm schematic grid.
